messages:
Indra: Quick sync — operator contract gating for private deployments. Need to finalize governance acceptance gates before Q2 planning. what are the absolute must-haves for us to sign off on an upgrade path?
Lex: Minimal list from eng-platform POV: smoke rollback, IP-preserve, KV/cache warmup, config-drift detection, and explicit SLOs around request error-rate during roll.
Camila: Security needs: per-tenant audit logs retained for 90 days, KMS integration (customer-managed keys), HSM support later. also require network isolation proof (no unexpected outbound flows). :lock:
ops-bot: doc created: https://go/redwood/private-operator-contract-gating (draft) — added initial checklist.
Lex: proposing a short checklist we can automate:
- run smoke tests against staging tenant
- run `kubectl rollout status` equivalent check for operator and runtime pods
- verify egress rules by running internal netcat probe (expect 0 allowed except control-plane if enabled)
- validate KV cache warmstart within Xs: metric compare to baseline
- run automated rollback scenario and confirm traffic shifted to fallback model

Sample rollback command we can expose to customers:
```
redwood operator rollback --tenant $TENANT --to-version v1.12.2
```
Nora: Field note — several large customers mandate zero-ejection (can't lose tenant IPs) and strict airgap (no control-plane egress). For those we need an "operator-offline" mode that ships signed offline bundles and a verification harness. that's higher priority than HSM for some deals.
Indra: Good call. Suggested prioritization:
1) Operator-offline / airgap upgrade flow + signed offline bundles + verification harness (P0 for deals that block revenue)
2) KMS / customer-managed keys & audit retention (P1)
3) Operator lifecycle API + automated rollback / canary policies (P2)
4) Formal SLA language + pricing delta for long upgrade windows (P2)
Who volunteers to own each?
Camila: I'll take KMS & audit retention test plan. will draft acceptance tests by Fri.
Lex: I'll own operator-offline prototype and the lifecycle API spec. pairing with ops for the verification harness. ETA: two sprints for prototype.
Nora: I'll collate the field cases that require airgap + IP preservation and prioritize customer list. also will create a minimal customer acceptance template for legal & sales.
Indra: Ops: can you confirm the verification harness needs and infra assumptions? and finance: we need a quick price delta model for longer windows. cc @ops, @finance.
ops-bot: reminder: weekly "private-deploy" sync Tue 10am — putting follow-up agenda item: operator contract gates.
Lex: Flag: rollout window length affects throughput and reserved capacity costs; finance input needed before we lock SLA.
Camila: note: add a test for key rotation behavior during live upgrades (rotation should not interrupt model decrypt).
Nora: +1 to that test. also add a checklist item: "customer signs offline bundle verification attestation" for airgap customers.
Indra: OK let's capture owners in the doc and convert checklist items into automated CI checks where feasible. I'll follow up with draft PR to the doc and a proposed sprint slice. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
